{{Quote|We're being swindled. Who sells a ship with only enough fuel to reach this lousy rock?|Moralo Eval|<ref name="FAE" />}}
'''Orondia''' was a desolate<ref name="FAE" /> [[Planet|world]]<ref name="Cad Bane">{{Databank|cad-bane-biography-gallery|Cad Bane Biography Gallery}} {{C|Slide 18}}</ref> in the [[Orondia system]] in [[Hutt Space]].<ref name="Appendix" /> During the [[Clone Wars]], [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]], disguised as [[Rako Hardeen]], [[Cad Bane]], and [[Moralo Eval]] were scammed into stopping there when a [[Bith]] gave him only enough [[fuel]] to reach Orondia, where his brother ran a fueling station.<ref name="FAE" />
